remarks: Welcome to this beautifully maintained and exceptionally clean half duplex, offering comfort, functionality, and a fantastic location! The bright, open-concept main floor features a spacious living area seamlessly connected to the kitchen and dining space, perfect for everyday living and entertaining. Enjoy a timeless kitchen with rich dark cabinetry, ample counter space, and a convenient pantry for additional storage. A tasteful combination of ceramic tile and vinyl plank flooring adds both style and durability throughout. Upstairs, you'll find a generously sized primary bedroom complete with its own ensuite, along with two additional well-sized bedrooms and a full 4-piece bathroom. Step outside to a fully fenced backyard, offering a great space to relax or enjoy outdoor activities. Situated on a regular-sized lot, this move-in-ready home is conveniently located close to public transit, shopping, and everyday amenities. An excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, families, or investors! (id:67522)
